subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “A community group posted the correct information with the official schedule.”?
options: The teacher explained that digital images also require respect.
The students also asked shop owners about business.
Wildlife experts warned residents not to feed it.
They also explained how residents could give suggestions.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「The teacher explained that digital images also require respect.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The students also asked shop owners about business.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Wildlife experts warned residents not to feed it.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「A community group posted the correct information with the official schedule. They also explained how residents could give suggestions.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「A community group posted the correct information with the official schedule. They also explained how residents could give suggestions.」，答案為「They also explained how residents could give suggestions.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「They also explained how residents could give suggestions.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
